Data Centers Are Not Significant Job Creators
The other justification for billions in tax breaks is the promise of job creation, despite the fact that

, including both higher-paid technicians and lower-wage security, landscaping, and janitorial roles, who may be subcontractors. The promised jobs numbers are often vastly inflated by temporary construction positions, with no guarantee these roles will go to local workers. Subcontracting practices with specialized temp agencies hire data center workers in temporary positions without benefits, rather than as direct employees, as in the case of a Google facility in Council Bluffs, Iowa. High-paid construction roles, such as electricians, are often filled by workers who travel from project to project across the country.
